Hi Tessa / Monica,

We discovered a discrepancy on our August invoice (INV-NC-202608) related to the seat increase we processed on 2026-08-18. We added 12 seats mid-billing cycle but the invoice shows the full-month charge for those seats instead of a prorated amount. Our procurement team needs an adjusted invoice and a credit for the overcharge so our AP team can close the month.

Summary: 
- Original subscription: 120 seats at the start of August
- Change on 2026-08-18: +12 seats (new total 132)
- Billing cadence: monthly, calendar month
- Expected: pro-rated charge for 12 seats from 2026-08-18 to 2026-08-31

Can you confirm how Redwood plans to handle the mid-month addition? We also need the VAT treatment spelled out (we are VAT-registered in the US branch). I attached our usage export; happy to share any additional logs.

Attachments: usage_report_august.csv (csv)

Thanks,

Hi Lydia / team — thanks for the details and the usage export. I ran the reconciliation against our provisioning events and attached a draft credit note + corrected invoice. Below is the approach we used and the numbers.

What we did
- Verified seat change event: 2026-08-18 14:31:12 UTC (matches your export)
- Billing rule applied: calendar-month pro-rata by day (our standard for monthly plans)
- Calculation (simplified):
  • Daily rate per seat (net): $0.45
  • Seats added: 12
  • Days charged at full on new seats: 14 days (8/18–8/31 inclusive)
  • Gross prorated charge for added seats: 12 seats * $0.45 * 14 days = $75.60
  • Original invoice charged full month for 12 seats: 12 * $0.45 * 31 = $167.40
  • Overcharge (amount to credit): $91.80 (net)

VAT handling
- Original invoice contained US VAT line at 10% (for example purposes).
- Draft credit reflects net credit and VAT reversal line so AP can match.
- If Novacorp prefers a single net credit applied to Sep invoice instead of reissuing a corrected August invoice, we can do that; the credit will still include VAT reversal lines for bookkeeping.

Attachments: draft_credit_note_sep.pdf (pdf), invoice_202608_aug-rebill.pdf (pdf)

Next steps
1) Please confirm you want (A) corrected August invoice + credit note OR (B) apply credit to September invoice and skip reissue.
2) If you choose (A), we'll produce a DocuSign-ready corrected invoice and credit note (link below) and finalize within 48 hours after approval.

DocuSign preview: https://na1.docusign.net/DocuSign/Start/ABC-INV-9783
Invoice record: https://app.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-NC-202608

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want to walk through the math.

Regards,
Monica Patel
